messages:
marco: hey team — final release cutoff at 22:00 UTC (in ~6h). please add changelog entries to your PRs before cutoff. entries must follow the template: short single-line bullet, component prefix, summary, PR link. see <https://redwood.internal/docs/release-notes-template|release notes template>. if you're only doing a bump, add the 'bump: patch' label and a one-line note.

elaine park: added entry for PR #4823 — dropped in the PR description. can someone quick skim format?

sam cole: looks close. small nits: use present-tense verb and component tag. e.g.
```
- eng-runtime: reduce KV cache memory by ~10% (PR #4823)
```
also drop internal implementation details.

cheng li: can we extend cutoff by 1h? there's one more patch waiting on tests.

marco: sadly no, can't extend — dependents already frozen for build. if needed, merge as post-release hotfix and bump patch.

release-bot: CI checks for PR #4823 — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

dev-bot: reminder — release checklist item 'changelogs present' currently 87% complete :eyes: 

elaine park: thanks @sam cole fixed wording and moved to PR body. pinging @cheng li for final review.

sam cole: acked. formatting lgtm :thumbsup: 

marco: thanks all — I'll do a final sweep 30m before cutoff. if you can't get changes in, please add a comment in the PR linking to this thread.

cheng li: merging now, will watch for fallout.

elaine park: merging too, thanks. good luck :rocket:
